risk_if_not_implemented: Without Honeyclients, security may be bolted on rather than designed in, resulting in structural weaknesses that are costly to remediate and easy to exploit. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2).

compensating_control_1.name: Network Intrusion Detection / Prevention Systems (NIDS / NIPS)
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to employ Network Intrusion Detection / Prevention Systems (NIDS/NIPS) to detect and/or prevent intrusions into the network.
compensating_control_1.justification: Network Intrusion Detection / Prevention Systems (NIDS / NIPS) (NET-31) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Honeyclients (SEA-21) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Anomalous Behavior
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize User & Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) and/or User Activity Monitoring (UAM) solutions to detect and respond to anomalous behavior that could indicate account compromise or other malicious activities.
compensating_control_2.justification: Anomalous Behavior (MON-16) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Honeyclients (SEA-21) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
